scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-convex-env.mjs && concurrently -k -n convex,server,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous npx convex dev" "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/backend/index.mjs
scripts.image:publish: docker buildx build --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) --platform ${IMAGE_PLATFORMS:-linux/amd64,linux/arm64} --tag ${IMAGE_NAME:?Set IMAGE_NAME to the registry/repository}:${IMAGE_TAG:-latest} --push .
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && node --test tests/backend.test.mjs tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test tests/hub.test.mjs tests/browserAudio.test.mjs tests/chatLinks.test.mjs tests/laser.test.mjs
